lines.zh: 我跳两步，再扑翅飞一小段。
lines.en: Two hops, then a short burst of wings.

lines.zh: 田埂上落着一排我的脚印。
lines.en: A row of my prints marks the field ridge.

lines.zh: 麦子熟了，我绕着地头转。
lines.en: The wheat is ripe; I circle the field's edge.

lines.zh: 我飞过篱笆，落在稻草人肩上。
lines.en: I cross the fence and land on the scarecrow.

lines.zh: 黑色的翅膀一开，影子扫过田。
lines.en: My black wings open; my shadow sweeps the field.

lines.zh: 我沿着村子的小路找吃的。
lines.en: I work along the village path for food.

lines.zh: 谷仓顶上风大，我压低身子。
lines.en: The barn roof is windy; I keep low.

lines.zh: 我叼着一根麦穗飞回树上。
lines.en: I carry a wheat ear back up to my tree.

lines.zh: 田里的南瓜排成一排，我绕开。
lines.en: Pumpkins line the field; I give them room.

lines.zh: 我落在牛背上，搭一段顺风。
lines.en: I ride a cow's back for a stretch.

lines.zh: 三只同伴在树上叫，我飞过去。
lines.en: Three of my kin call from the tree; I join.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，找掉落的种子。
lines.en: I fly low, hunting fallen seeds.

lines.zh: 雪地上我的爪印一串串。
lines.en: My claw prints trail in strings across snow.

lines.zh: 我跳上犁过的土，翻找虫子。
lines.en: I hop onto plowed soil and turn up grubs.
I hop from the roof onto the haystack.

lines.zh: 我绕过农夫的叉子，去抢谷粒。
lines.en: I dodge the farmer's fork and go for the grain.

lines.zh: 平原上的乌鸦，只捡亮的东西。
lines.en: A plains crow only picks up shiny things.
My shadow caught up.
No signs up here.
One loop, then home.
Nice current through here.
Don't hit the tree, don't.
Don't look down, don't.
Is that tree moving?
I'll skirt around this forest.
Height is safety, mostly.
Keep a low profile in flight.
I smell water nearby.
Who moved the clouds away?
I know the night path.
The wind's pushing west today.
Steadier than yesterday, I think.

lines.zh: 我蹲在枝头，整理胸前的羽毛。
lines.en: Perched, I smooth the feathers on my breast.

lines.zh: 树林里没什么事，我叫两声。
lines.en: Nothing stirs in the wood, so I call twice.

lines.zh: 我用喙梳理翅膀下的绒毛。
lines.en: I comb the down under my wing with my beak.

lines.zh: 风把树叶吹得响，我歪头听。
lines.en: Wind rattles the leaves; I tilt my head.
Someone is in the field; I wait them out.

lines.zh: 这块干草垛很暖，我多待一会。
lines.en: This hay bale is warm; I linger a while.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进肩里，眯一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck my head into my shoulders and doze.

lines.zh: 远处有乌鸦叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: A crow calls far off; I answer once.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓牢树枝，一动不动。
lines.en: My claws grip the branch and I hold still.
Sun on black feathers makes them hot.

lines.zh: 我在数田里有几行麦子。
lines.en: I am counting the rows of wheat.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里动，我盯着看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the grass; I stare.
Fold wings, close eyes, drift.
I remember flowers here.
Just one short nap.
The night is still long.
Resting my wings a moment.
The wind died. Awful.
Counting clouds: one, two.
Should I head back to the nest?
Good height for spacing out.
I hear distant thunder.
I don't want to move.
Someone walks below us.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我们的时候，我正看你。
lines.en: You look up for us; I was already watching.

lines.zh: 你的帽子上有亮片，我记住了。
lines.en: There's a shiny bit on your hat; noted.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋种子，我很感兴趣。
lines.en: That bag of seeds in your hand interests me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，用一只眼看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and fix one eye on you.

lines.zh: 你走近，我就往高枝上跳。
lines.en: You come close, so I hop to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 你在田边插了个南瓜，是防我的吧。
lines.en: That pumpkin by the field is meant to stop me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看你要撒什么。
lines.en: I watch your hand to see what you scatter.

lines.zh: 你咳了一声，我扑翅换了个位置。
lines.en: You cough, and I flutter to another perch.

lines.zh: 你的影子在田里拉得很长，我跟着。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches across the field; I follow.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你才抬头。
lines.en: I had watched you long before you looked up.
You carry the smell of grain.

lines.zh: 你伸出手，我先退半步再看看。
lines.en: You reach out; I retreat half a step, then look.

lines.zh: 你的稻草人比你会站，我更喜欢它。
lines.en: Your scarecrow stands better than you; I prefer it.

lines.zh: 我冲你叫一声，看你怎么回。
lines.en: I call at you once to see how you answer.
I've been watching you.
I counted your steps.
Looking for something in the sky?
You looked up.
One circle, then I'll judge you.
There's light behind you.
Coming up here or not?

lines.zh: 你手上那点亮东西，晃眼。
lines.en: That shiny thing in your hand is blinding.
Look up and don't blink.
Don't point that at me.

lines.zh: 我被石子打中翅膀，歪着落下。
lines.en: A stone hits my wing; I drop off balance.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛掉了，我飞开一点。
lines.en: A feather comes loose; I fly a bit off.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着跳到更高的枝上。
lines.en: Screaming, I leap to a higher branch.

lines.zh: 这下手太重，我扑腾着退后。
lines.en: That was too hard; I flap backward.

lines.zh: 我躲进树叶里，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I hide in the leaves with one eye out.

lines.zh: 疼得我叫不出声，只张着嘴。
lines.en: The pain leaves me gaping, voiceless.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，看你还在不在。
lines.en: I circle half around to see if you stayed.

lines.zh: 翅膀使不上力，我只能跳。
lines.en: My wing won't work; I can only hop.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，又挣扎着飞起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground and struggle back up.

lines.zh: 我记住打我的那只手了。
lines.en: I have memorized the hand that struck me.
A plains crow holds a grudge.
Black feathers scatter on the ground.
My wing! Watch it!
That was too heavy.
That one really stung.
Nothing much… ow, though.
A wing buckled. I can't hold steady.
Ow! Who hit me?
Sss, easy there now.
I can take this.
Pumpkin seeds; I know them by smell.

lines.zh: 你摊开手心，我落低一点。
lines.en: You open your palm and I drop lower.

lines.zh: 那几粒种子够我吃半天。
lines.en: Those few seeds would keep me busy a while.
Don't shake your hand; the seeds will fall.

lines.zh: 我装作看别处，脚却往前挪了。
lines.en: I look elsewhere, but my feet creep forward.

lines.zh: 你把籽放在石头上，我就下来。
lines.en: Set them on the stone and I'll come down.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒，飞回枝头慢慢磕。
lines.en: I take one and fly up to crack it open.

lines.zh: 这味道比田里的麦子香。
lines.en: This smells better than the wheat out there.

lines.zh: 你还带着壳吗？我喜欢自己剥。
lines.en: Are they still in shells? I like opening them.
My kin have seen this; they will come to steal.
That smell makes me dizzy.
Wherever you go, I fly along.
Is it sweet? I like sweet.
What's that? Smells good.
Drop a few crumbs for me.
I'll trade you something shiny.

lines.zh: 平原上的亮东西我都记得在哪。
lines.en: I remember where every shiny thing lies.
One taste, I promise.
The crumbs you drop are mine.
Anything else in your bag?

lines.zh: 我撞在你的肩膀上，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and my feathers ruffle.

lines.zh: 你抬手挥开我，我翻了个身。
lines.en: You wave me off and I tumble in the air.

lines.zh: 两只乌鸦抢一个枝头，撞得乱飞。
lines.en: Two of us fight for one perch and scatter.

lines.zh: 我落在你帽檐上，差点滑下去。
lines.en: I land on your hat brim and nearly slide off.
Wind shoves me into the fence.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的手臂飞过，翅尖擦到。
lines.en: I skim your arm and my wingtip catches it.
The branch is thin; it sways when I land.

lines.zh: 同伴从背后撞我，抢我的籽。
lines.en: A comrade hits me from behind for my seed.

lines.zh: 我撞进麦秆里，扑腾着出来。
lines.en: I crash into the stalks and flap my way out.

lines.zh: 你转身时撞到我，我跳开半步。
lines.en: You turn into me; I hop half a step aside.
Stop pushing me, please.
You did that on purpose.
Where was my flight path?
Can't I just fly around?
My wing! That hurts.
Who? Who hit me?
Sorry, I couldn't brake.
You're a big lump.
Move, I'm coming through.
This wall is moving.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的那片羽毛递过去。
lines.en: I offer the brightest feather I have.

lines.zh: 它跳过来，用喙碰我的喙。
lines.en: It hops over and touches its beak to mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，尾巴一翘一翘。
lines.en: We stand abreast, tails flicking.

lines.zh: 我给它衔了一粒南瓜籽。
lines.en: I bring it a pumpkin seed.
It calls once, and I call back.

lines.zh: 这根高枝是我们共同的。
lines.en: This high branch belongs to both of us.

lines.zh: 我在它身边转圈，翅膀半开。
lines.en: I circle beside it, wings half open.

lines.zh: 它把头靠过来，我不动了。
lines.en: It leans its head near, and I go still.

lines.zh: 我们一起把树枝加厚一点。
lines.en: Together we thicken the nest with twigs.

lines.zh: 等它吃完，我们再一起飞。
lines.en: When it finishes eating, we fly off together.
Let's circle this tree together.
Our wings share a rhythm.
I waited a whole season.
Circle with me a while?
Wings open. See them?
My nest sits up high.
Will you land beside me?
Let's return to the nest.
Our wings beat together.
This height belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我叼起那枚亮东西，藏进树洞。
lines.en: I take the shiny thing and hide it in a hollow.

lines.zh: 一粒南瓜籽，我含在舌下。
lines.en: One pumpkin seed, held under my tongue.

lines.zh: 我把麦穗拖到枝头，慢慢磕。
lines.en: I drag a wheat ear up and crack it apart.

lines.zh: 这枚铁片太重，我拖着走。
lines.en: This iron scrap is heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我偷走的纽扣藏在树皮缝里。
lines.en: The button I stole is wedged in bark.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛叼给同伴当礼物。
lines.en: I carry a feather to a comrade as a gift.

lines.zh: 我叼着虫子，飞回窝里喂小的。
lines.en: I bring a grub back to feed the young.

lines.zh: 那块面包渣，我藏了三处。
lines.en: That bread crumb, I hid in three places.

lines.zh: 我用喙把籽壳剥开，叼出仁。
lines.en: My beak splits the shell and lifts the kernel.
Anything shiny, I want to carry off.
My grip is steady.
Let me sniff it first.
Tuck it in my claws.
Useful. Taking it.
Could I trade this for something?
Don't blame me if I drop it.
Almost dropped it there.
Who dropped it? Mine now.
This goes in my nest.
Another piece for my collection.

lines.zh: 田里有一行麦子，我先去那。
lines.en: A row of wheat is ripe; I go there first.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫爬出来了，我盯住它。
lines.en: A beetle emerges; I fix my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子袋，是个好目标。
lines.en: That seed bag of yours is a fine target.

lines.zh: 稻草人不会动，我才不怕。
lines.en: The scarecrow can't move; it doesn't scare me.

lines.zh: 我看见一条虫子钻进土里。
lines.en: I saw a worm burrow into the soil.

lines.zh: 那边有人在收麦，机会来了。
lines.en: Someone is harvesting over there; my chance.

lines.zh: 同伴发现了好东西，我飞过去。
lines.en: A comrade found something good; I fly over.
That chicken is pecking; I'll go rob it.

lines.zh: 有只猫在墙头，我先记下。
lines.en: A cat sits on the wall; I make a note.

lines.zh: 地上有东西在反光，我锁定了。
lines.en: Something glints on the ground; I lock on.
One move from you and I dive.
bugs, start running.
I light on the branch and fix on you.
Big prey today.
Now is the moment.
I'm hungry now.
You're inside my range.
Your shadow gives you away.
I see your opening.
There's nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我落在三步远，等它放松。
lines.en: I land three paces off and wait for it to relax.

lines.zh: 我歪头又歪头，量着距离。
lines.en: I tilt my head this way and that, judging.
When it moves, I hop a block nearer.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，翅膀收紧了。
lines.en: I lower myself and tuck my wings tight.
It turns its back to me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我从草叶后面看它，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I watch it through the grass and edge closer.

lines.zh: 它抬起头，我立刻装作看天。
lines.en: It looks up; I pretend to study the sky.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的喙就够到了。
lines.en: A little closer and my beak can reach.

lines.zh: 同伴在树上放哨，我往前。
lines.en: A comrade keeps watch in the tree; I advance.
I count to three and then dive.

lines.zh: 那片林子挡着，你过不去。
lines.en: That stand of trees blocks you.
Faster than I guessed.
Folding my wings, I get there first.
You're panting now.
You hear my wings.
I'm flying through the trees.
I stay above you.
One loop, then I return.
You looked the wrong way.
You turn. So do I.

lines.zh: 我一喙啄下去，叼住了它。
lines.en: I stab down with my beak and hold it.

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住，一下一下地啄。
lines.en: I pin it with my claws and peck away.

lines.zh: 它挣扎，我把它甩到地上。
lines.en: It wriggles; I fling it to the ground.

lines.zh: 我扑翅吓它，趁它乱就下口。
lines.en: I beat my wings to startle it, then strike.
This peck lands square in the middle.

lines.zh: 我不松口，往后拖了两步。
lines.en: I hold on and drag it back two steps.
It tries to flee; I hop across and cut it off.
I beat its head with my wings.

lines.zh: 抢食的同伴被我啄了一下。
lines.en: I peck the comrade stealing my food.

lines.zh: 啄完我就跳开，看看情况。
lines.en: After the peck I hop back and check.
Diving down at you!
One wingbeat sends you off.
Stop struggling. Save your strength.
Sharp, see? Very sharp.
Move, or you're next.
Taste my wing strike.
These claws were never trimmed.
This claw is for you.
I'm ramming you—flap!
Biting down on you!

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里挣出来，全身黏着。
lines.en: I struggle out of the shell, still sticky.

lines.zh: 第一声叫，就把整棵树吵醒了。
lines.en: My first call wakes the whole tree.

lines.zh: 树林上空有一群黑影，我加入了。
lines.en: Dark shapes ride the treetops; I join them.

lines.zh: 我试着扇翅，飞起两格又落下。
lines.en: I flap, rise two blocks, then drop.

lines.zh: 田里的麦子比我高很多。
lines.en: The wheat in the field stands far above me.

lines.zh: 我落在一根矮枝上，梳理羽毛。
lines.en: I land on a low branch and preen.
Here there are fallen ears in plenty.

lines.zh: 我看见远处的稻草人在风里晃。
lines.en: I see a scarecrow rocking in the wind.

lines.zh: 同伴教我怎么翻土找虫。
lines.en: My kin teach me to turn soil for grubs.
My black feathers slowly dry.
Two wingbeats to start.
I smell something alive.
My feathers is still here.
They call me Crow.
My wings aren't open yet.
Has the sky brightened yet?
Let me fly longer this time.
First time opening my eyes.
So high. Don't fall.
Where are the flowers here?

lines.zh: 火苗窜上羽毛，我急忙扑打。
lines.en: Flame climbs my feathers; I beat them out.
My wings are smoking.

lines.zh: 我从高枝摔下，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: I fall from the high branch, wings unopened.
The ground is rushing up.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛里，我沉了一下。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I go under.
Water's soaking my wings.
The blast throws me into the wheat.

lines.zh: 炸响把羽毛都掀起来了。
lines.en: The blast blew my feathers up.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦掉了我的尾羽。
lines.en: An arrow clips off my tail feathers.
No more cheap shots.

lines.zh: 紫光罩下来，我的翅膀僵住。
lines.en: Violet light falls and my wings stiffen.
This isn't a normal wound.

lines.zh: 田里空了，我的肚子也空了。
lines.en: The field is bare, and so is my belly.
Too hungry to fly.

lines.zh: 雷光把黑羽毛照得发白。
lines.en: Lightning bleaches my black feathers white.
Feathers singed; my flight's crooked.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一直在坠落。
lines.en: There is nothing under my claws; I keep dropping.
There's no wind here.
